title: Studio 仪表盘属性面板：默认期间下拉显示原始值（today、this_month…），没有选项名（#36835 的同一缺陷，在仪表盘表单上）
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① an experience defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7129188207, item 1). Source: a jsdom probe by the #36835 dev (PR #36928), not committed.

Blocked-by: #36928

## What happens

In Studio, a dashboard's Properties panel has a Default Period select. It shows the raw preset values (`today`, `yesterday`, …, `this_month`, `custom`) instead of their names. The `dateRange` composite in `dashboard.form.ts` declares no children, so the row falls back to the schema enum. This is the same defect that #36835 fixes on the report form.

reach: every builder who sets a dashboard's default period in Studio, in every locale. Read from a jsdom probe and not yet seen in a browser.

## Expected

The select names each period, in the builder's language, the same way the report form does after #36928.

## Acceptance

- The dashboard form gets the same fix shape as #36928, so the two forms share it rather than repeat it.
- A test pins that the dashboard Default Period options carry labels, in at least zh-CN and en.

Dedupe: open issues for the dashboard default period return only #36835, the report form.
